themes.name: GTA 6 launch
rules: Facts and history only: launch numbers, the 13-year gap since GTA V, the two delays, the setting, studio and development history, records.

NEVER use gameplay footage, trailers, screenshots, cover art, logos or character likenesses. All visuals are our own original pixel-art and HUD scenes, per the Gaming profile in skills/unseen-facts-category-styles.
No leaks, rumours or review-bombing drama. Only facts reported by named sources.

themes.name: Gold price drop
rules: Explain WHY, with mechanisms: real yields and the opportunity cost of a non-yielding asset, dollar strength, Fed rate expectations, forced selling to meet margin calls, ETF flows, central-bank buying.
Strictly focus on macroeconomic mechanisms. Exclude retail jewellery demand, jewellery manufacturing warnings, or consumer retail commentary.
Every number must come from a source published in the last 48 hours and be stated with its date ("as of 20 November"). Never a number from memory.
Forecasts are attributed opinions, never facts: "Standard Chartered expects..." not "gold will fall to...".
NO advice: never say buy, sell, hold, wait, or "now is a good time". Never imply the narrator is an analyst or advisor.
Add this to the end of each gold description: "This is general information, not financial advice."
